faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions on Guest Trust
faq.intro: Complete clarity regarding my verification methods, guide ethics, and direct traveler references.

verified.q: Are these guest reviews genuinely unedited and verified?
verified.a: Every review featured on Serendiva originates from real travelers I have personally guided. I cross-verify entries submitted through TripAdvisor, Google Business, and post-trip direct guest notes. I never edit guest impressions, delete critical observations, or incentivize praise through compensation.

rating.q: How do you maintain such consistent five-star feedback?
rating.a: It stems from absolute personal accountability. I never sub-contract my journeys to anonymous third-party taxi apps or volume agencies. I personally oversee vehicle maintenance, itinerary pacing, dietary checks, and private route clearance for every group, and I limit how many journeys I host at once to guarantee artisanal hospitality.

references.q: Can I speak directly with a past traveler from my home country before planning my trip?
references.a: Yes. Many of my former guests—spanning the UK, US, Australia, Switzerland, and Scandinavia—have graciously agreed to act as direct references for curious prospective travelers. Just ask, and I will connect you privately via email with a guest who traveled on an itinerary similar to yours.

weather.q: What happens if unexpected weather or road conditions affect our itinerary?
weather.a: As a licensed National Tourist Guide Lecturer with intimate island knowledge, I adjust routes fluidly without disrupting your comfort. If hill country monsoons affect scenic train operations or tea walks, I pivot toward alternative protected valleys, bespoke tea factory tastings, or cultural sanctuaries with zero logistical stress on your part.

steps.write: Write in your own words — praise, suggestions and critical notes are all welcome.
steps.moderate: I read every submission personally and publish it after a short moderation, usually within a few days.
